text:
jordan c: Quick sync 16: SEO checklist for next week's product launch + webinar page. Need to finalize redirects, schema, and lead routing today.
preeti s: On redirects. We have three legacy paths that should 301 to the new platform hub. I'll post the mapping in a sec.
noah b: For copy, i'm drafting a benchmark post (latency vs cost for low-latency LLM serving) and a tactical how-to that points to the webinar signup.
jordan c: good. For schema we want Event, FAQ, BreadcrumbList, and Organization in the footer. Also add HowTo on the quickstart where it makes sense.
preeti s: redirect map draft:
```
/guide/inference-old -> /platform/inference/get-started
/benchmarks/inference-2023 -> /platform/inference/benchmarks-2026
/signup/webinar-old -> /events/real-time-llm-launch
```
Apply 301s, preserve query params/UTM. We'll set Referrer-Policy to same-origin on the target pages.
noah b: internal linking plan: cluster pages into a hub: launch post -> benchmarks -> quickstart -> webinar -> faq. Keep 2-4 links per page, contextual, not footer spam.
jordan c: canonical decisions: if two pages share intent, canonicalize to the hub and use a short summary page for the other intent. flag any potential cannibalization.
preeti s: hreflang: add en-US and en-GB where we have localized copy. Also ensure alternate hreflang points to the canonical URLs.
kate (ops-bot): reminder: staging headers must be removed before indexing. set X-Robots-Tag: none on staging until QA complete.
noah b: analytics: registration form should append utm_source=email|organic, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=llm-launch. GA4 event: 'webinar_signup' with param campaign=llm-launch.
jordan c: HubSpot workflow: route webinar leads to SDR queue 'Webinar-Launch-2026', tag lead_source=webinar and add note with page URL.
preeti s: sitemap and robots: regenerate sitemap.xml, make sure /platform/inference/ pages are included and noindex on staging-only versions.
kate (ops-bot): scheduled sitemap ping to Search Console set for 2026-03-26 08:00 UTC. CI note: please run crawl after redirects are live.
noah b: testing plan: use curl to confirm 301 and preserved query string; run Screaming Frog for canonical + hreflang checks; run structured data testing tool for JSON-LD.
jordan c: content: headline must include the primary keyword but keep it readable. please provide two title variants. also create a short meta description that mentions webinar CTA.
preeti s: i'll push the redirect rules to the staging redirect file tonight and share a spreadsheet with exact regex rules.
noah b: quick SEO copy note: avoid repeating the same H1 on both the benchmark and the how-to. differentiate intent (benchmarks = evaluative, how-to = practical).
jordan c: timeline: redirects staged by EOD tomorrow, schema + canonical live at publish time, analytics wire-up before launch email goes out.
preeti s: i'll run the post-deploy crawl and report any 404 chains or redirect loops.
kate (ops-bot): deploy-checklist: confirm 301s, update sitemap.xml, ping Search Console, verify structured data, and confirm GA4 event created. :white_check_mark:
jordan c: thanks team. drop the title options and the redirect spreadsheet link in this thread when ready.
preeti s: will do, adding regex notes and UTM-preserve examples in the sheet.
noah b: thanks all :rocket:
